name: chatgpt-codex-plugin-autopilot
description: Convert agentic repositories into focused ChatGPT/Codex plugins, then validate, package, and prepare them for submission

interface.longDescription: Finds reusable agentic workflows inside existing repositories, helps decide what should become public Skills or runtime-backed capabilities, compiles portable Skill packages, designs a clear Plugin experience and SVG brand identity, prepares Plugin Directory metadata, validates the package contract, produces deterministic installable ZIPs, and prepares reviewer evidence without confusing local validation with public approval.
defaultPrompt: Turn this agentic repository into a clean ChatGPT/Codex Plugin.
Find the reusable workflows in this repo and decide what should become Skills.
Validate and package this Plugin for submission.
